title: Claude Desktop virtual machine
description: Image of the isolated virtual machine in which Claude Desktop runs agent work (code, files). It contains the operating system and the tool environment.
regeneration: Claude Desktop downloads the image again when needed (several GB).

title: Claude Desktop cache
description: Cache of the browser built into Claude Desktop (pages, scripts, GPU shaders).

title: Claude Code session transcripts
description: Records of Claude Code conversations, one per project and session. Used to resume sessions (claude --resume) and for history. Project memory folders (memory) are not shown here. Claude Code deletes sessions older than 30 days by itself (the cleanupPeriodDays setting in ~/.claude/settings.json), so usually only recent ones are here.
regeneration: Cannot be recreated; a removed session cannot be resumed.

title: Claude Code temporary files
description: Debug logs, shell snapshots and task lists from finished Claude Code sessions.

title: Claude Code file history
description: Copies of files from before edits, used to undo changes in a session (checkpoints).
regeneration: Cannot be recreated; you lose the ability to undo changes in older sessions.

title: Old Claude Code versions
description: Previous versions of Claude Code (about 220 MB each); the newest is kept. Sessions started on an older version keep running until they are closed.

title: claude-mem logs
description: Logs of the claude-mem memory plugin.

title: Codex sessions
description: Records of Codex conversations, grouped by day. Used to resume sessions.

title: Archived Codex sessions
description: Records of Codex conversations you archived.

title: Codex worktrees
description: Working copies of a repository (git worktree) created by Codex tasks. They may contain uncommitted work, so check the Git status shown for the item. After removing the folder, run git worktree prune in the repository.

title: Cursor worktrees
description: Working copies of a repository (git worktree) created by Cursor agents. They may contain uncommitted work, so check the Git status shown for the item. After removing the folder, run git worktree prune in the repository.

title: Codex temporary files and logs
description: Temporary files and logs of Codex CLI.

title: Codex runtimes
description: Downloaded environments (Node, Python and tools) in which Codex runs commands.
regeneration: Codex downloads them again the next time it starts.

title: Codex app cache
description: Cache of the Codex and CodexBar apps.

title: Hugging Face models
description: Models and datasets downloaded from Hugging Face (e.g. Whisper for superwhisper and MLX, pyannote and speechbrain models for speaker recognition). Files are shared within each store, so a store is removed as a whole. Your login token is stored next to it and is kept.
regeneration: The app downloads the model again the next time it is used (often several GB).

title: Hugging Face Datasets cache
description: Data that the datasets library prepared from downloads and your processing steps (Arrow files). Processed variants may need your scripts and computing time to recreate.
regeneration: The datasets library prepares the data again when a script loads it.

title: PyTorch models
description: Model weights downloaded by torch.hub and PyTorch-based libraries.

title: Whisper models
description: Speech recognition models that OpenAI Whisper downloads.
regeneration: Whisper downloads the model again the next time it is used.

title: LM Studio models
description: Local language models downloaded in LM Studio.
regeneration: Download the model again in LM Studio.

title: Ollama models
description: Local Ollama models.

title: superwhisper recordings
description: Dictation recordings saved by superwhisper.

title: Claude Code bundled with Claude Desktop
description: Copies of Claude Code downloaded by the Claude Desktop app (for local mode and the virtual machine).

title: LM Studio runtimes (llama.cpp, MLX)
description: Model runtimes and plugins downloaded by LM Studio.
regeneration: LM Studio downloads the runtime the next time a model is loaded.

title: Claude Code plugins and settings
description: Installed plugins, marketplaces, skills and settings of Claude Code. Manage them with the /plugin command.

title: claude-mem memory
description: The claude-mem observation database and vector index.

title: Codex plugins and settings
description: Codex configuration, plugins and data.

title: Claude Desktop data
description: Settings, local agent sessions and sign-in data of Claude Desktop.

title: LM Studio data
description: Settings, chats and other LM Studio data.
